article.title: 工具補讀：商湯SenseNova 6.8 Flash擴展設計格式，主動辦公示範仍屬研發版
article.title_en: Tool review: SenseNova 6.8 Flash expands design formats; proactive office demos remain internal
article.summary: 11月2日中文原稿介紹動態簡報與3D設計，實際使用條件需按功能分開理解。
article.summary_en: The November 2 Chinese release describes animated presentations and 3D design, with different conditions across features.
highlights: 客戶跟進的主動互動示範標明內部研發版，3D流程需要本地環境。
highlights_en: Design formats include Web, SVG, PPT, Three.js and Blender.
Proactive customer-follow-up demos are labeled internal R&D; 3D work needs local setup.
article.why: 簡報及創意團隊可評估可繼續編輯的交付格式，同時把示範能力與現成服務分開列入採購要求。
article.why_en: Presentation and creative teams can assess editable outputs while separating demonstrated research capabilities from deployable services.
article.next_step: 先確認Design體驗及輸出格式，再以非機密簡報測試；如需Blender，先安排本地環境及覆核。
article.next_step_en: Confirm Design access and output formats, test a non-confidential brief, and prepare local setup and review for Blender.
article.detail: 原稿列出長期記憶與主動交互的辦公方向，客戶回訪及交接案例旁清楚註明使用小浣熊內部研發版，不能推斷全部用戶已有相同能力。Blender例子亦依賴本地環境及使用者多輪修訂。公司公布多項評測，本報沒有重做測試，因此不沿用領先其他模型的結論。這篇保留11月2日原始日期，作工具補讀，未把近日轉載當作新的推出事件。
article.detail_en: Customer follow-up and handover demonstrations explicitly use an internal R&D version. Blender requires local setup and user iterations. Vendor benchmark superiority is not independently reproduced here. This is a review of the November 2 release, not a new launch inferred from later coverage.
